high_level_description: stc brand style, a night scene of construction workers in hard hats at a work site, overlaid with drone and location-tracking icons.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A hazy nighttime construction site lit by warm floodlights, with a starry sky above.

elements.desc: A group of workers wearing hard hats and high-visibility vests, standing near construction scaffolding.
A man in the foreground wearing a hard hat and a safety vest, holding a tablet.
A row of drones flying in formation across the night sky, each connected by dashed lines to floating white icon panels showing a location pin and a tracking device.
